notes.title: Patch 01.03
notes.content:
[h3]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Various performance fixes
[*] Fixed Shroud and Takedown sometimes becoming unavailable
[*] Fixed occurrence of Agitator failing to die when their health reaches 0
[*] Fixed music sometimes playing twice
[/list]
 
[h3]CHARACTER ANIMATION:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Azad sliding after skipping certain cinematics in chapter Chamatkari Mandir
[*] Fixed Luther sometimes floating during combat in chapter Quinta Matos
[*] Fixed player sometimes getting stuck in chapter Anatolia
[*] Fixed not being able to climb down a climbable wall in chapter Peshanden
[*] Fixed Buchra sliding after a cinematic in chapter Reithden
[*] Fixed a rare issue of passing through the world when attempting to heal and climb at the same time
[/list]

[h3]LOCALIZATION:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue of an incorrect language sometimes being used when booting the game for the first time
[*] Multiple fixes on Japanese and English subtitles
[*] Fixed missing subtitles for the Relay Tower warning
[*] Renaming of some UI elements to clarify their purpose
[/list]

notes.title: Dive into the making of the Unknown 9 universe with a new trailer
notes.content:
[h2]Take in the scale and depth of the Unknown 9 universe with a new trailer, featuring insightful snippets from interviews of the minds who created or contributed to its creation.[/h2]

From talented actress [b]Anya Chalotra[/b] who portrays [b]Haroona[/b] in the video game [i]Unknown 9 Awakening[/i], to the many talents involved in the making of the [b]podcast, comic books, web series and novels[/b], this trailer goes behind the scenes and into the creations of each product of the [i]Unknown 9[/i] universe.

And today this universe expands further with the release of the third and final novel of the [b]Genesis Trilogy by Layton Green:[/b] [i]Ascension[/i]. This last novel brings a conclusion to the story of Andie, a brilliant young woman whose mentor mysteriously disappears, leaving her with a trail of clues that will lead her around the world and in the crossfire of feuding secret societies.

[h1][url=https://www.bandainamcoent.com/games/unknown9/]Discover more about the Genesis Book Trilogy here 📖[/url] [/h1]

notes.title: Step into Unknown 9: Awakening’s Gameplay Trailer 🎬
notes.content:
[h3]You play as Haroona, a fierce truth-seeker (what we call a “[i]Quaestor[/i]”) with a unique connection to another dimension known as the Fold. This other plane of existence contains powerful energy and long-lost knowledge that, if brought to light, could usher us into a wondrous era of advancement. However, if this forgotten wisdom falls into the wrong hands, it could lead to our inevitable demise.    [/h3]

[previewyoutube=dBE4VV-PuIE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]This quest will have you uncover the long-lost secrets of our collective past. Haroona will also learn to tap into the Fold’s energy, gifting her incredible skills, known as Umbric abilities, that allow her to take down anyone who stands in her way.

The gameplay shows Haroona Crushing, Pushing, and Pulling people and objects from a distance, and mysteriously Shielding herself from enemy fire. She also Steps into her opponents to take control of their minds, bodies, and weapons. These are just a few of the Umbric abilities you’ll use when you play the game. The closer we get to its release, the more of these skills we’ll reveal. 

Players looking to switch up their playstyle will be able to play in stealth, combat, and Umbric abilities mode. Each style has its advantages, but it’s the combination of the three that will provide you with the versatility needed to overcome whatever enemies cross your path. [/h3]

[h2][url=https://bnent.eu/U9Awakening]Believe in the Unknown. Learn more here.[/url][/h2]
